_comment: Shared source of truth for the Codex model-capability tables that both src-tauri/src/services/route_model_capability.rs and src/lib/codexModelCapability.ts implement. Each side has a test that compares its own constants to this file, so changing one without the other fails there rather than silently drifting until a client is told something the catalog will not honour. Update this file first, then both sides. `deepseek_v4_reasoning_levels` is the ladder both the Codex catalog AND third-party client configs use for an undeclared DeepSeek-V4 model — they used to disagree, and Codex was the side that lost `max`. `gpt-6.1-sol` stops at `max` (no `ultra`): its Responses upstream rejects `ultra`, and the default effort is the last tier.
